_doc: Product contract for the NFRI index site. Defines the category-redefining insurance product the index underwrites: parametric non-firm availability cover. Rendered by harness/build_essays.py into the '#product' section. Inline HTML and {{cite:KEY}} / {{fact:KEY}} tokens permitted in prose. Chart kinds 'flow' and 'boundaries' are self-contained (data embedded in the block). Edit prose here; never hand-edit generated HTML.

blocks.text: The cover the market sells today triggers on physical damage. A grid operator lawfully curtailing a non-firm connection breaks nothing — so the loss falls straight through the wording, uninsured.{{cite:LMA-BI-GUIDE}} The product that fits availability loss is the inverse of damage-based business interruption: a parametric availability cover that pays on a measured loss of grid availability at the asset's constraint boundary, indexed to curtailment, with no physical-damage requirement and no loss-adjustment lag.{{cite:LLOYDS-PARAMETRIC-CYBER,DESCARTES-DC-PARAMETRIC,REG-IAIS-PARAMETRIC}}

This is the category redefinition. Damage-based BI asks what broke; non-firm availability cover asks how many hours the connection was curtailable and curtailed. The first is a forensic claim settled in months; the second is a parametric trigger settled in days against a published index.{{cite:INSTECH-NDBI-PARAMETRIC,MARSH-UK-SLA-PARAMETRIC}} The same shift already happened for cloud-outage and SLA risk; non-firm power is the next availability risk to cross it.{{cite:PARAMETRIX-CLOUD-IN-A-BOX,MGA-PARAMETRIX-SLA}}

And the index is the engine, not the product. NFRI is not a score sold by the unit — it is the pricing operating system for this cover: the primary-source reconciliation of connection registers, curtailment data, filings and wordings that lets an underwriter set a trigger, a rate and a limit the rest of the market cannot.{{cite:AON-DCLP,INDUSTRY-PARAMETRIC-DC-FINANCING}} The score ranks the risk; the operating system writes the cover.
A new category: cover that pays on lost availability, not lost property — priced off the gap between how exposed an entity is and how prepared it is to carry that exposure.
How it operates at every level

blocks.caption: The cover attaches at the asset and travels up the tower. NFRI gives each level the same primary-source picture, priced.

items.name: Energy & data-centre assets — the insured exposure
items.role: Where the exposure sits: a non-firm, curtailable connection on a constrained boundary. The product attaches here as parametric availability cover, with the trigger calibrated to the asset's boundary curtailment probability and connection-gate status.
items.examples: Inputs: NESO TEC gate status, DNO flexible-connection share, boundary congestion. Cover: hours-of-availability index, indemnity per curtailed hour.

items.name: MGAs & brokers — structure and placement
items.role: Translate exposure into a placeable contract: set the parametric index, attachment and limit, and place the gap that damage-based wordings leave open. NFRI is the underwriting file that justifies the rate to capacity.
items.examples: Uses: Margin-of-Safety rank, sub-factor decomposition, evidence tiers per rating.

items.name: Carriers & Lloyd's syndicates — carry the risk
items.role: Hold the cover on balance sheet. NFRI tells a carrier where its book's exposure has run ahead of its preparedness — the negative Margin of Safety that flags accumulating risk before the loss history arrives.
items.examples: Uses: portfolio Margin-of-Safety distribution, book concentration, capital/reinsurance adequacy.

items.name: Reinsurers & capacity — aggregate and cede
items.role: Stand behind the tower. The decisive question is correlation: how much non-firm exposure shares the same grid geography and curtails together. NFRI's aggregation factor prices that shared-boundary accumulation directly.
items.examples: Uses: aggregation-correlation over constraint boundaries, HHI on shared geography.

blocks.caption: Parametric availability cover end to end. Every step reads a primary source, not an adjuster's estimate.

steps.title: Trigger
steps.detail: Measured loss of grid availability at the asset's constraint boundary — curtailment hours against the contracted firm baseline. Parametric, not damage-based.

steps.title: Measure
steps.detail: NFRI reads boundary curtailment probability and the entity's Exposure and Preparedness scores to size the bet and the capacity behind it.

steps.title: Price
steps.detail: Rate is set on the Margin-of-Safety gap: exposure unmatched by preparedness is where loss concentrates and where the rate must rise.

steps.title: Pay
steps.detail: Payout is indexed to curtailment against the published trigger — settled in days, no physical-damage proof, no multi-month loss adjustment.

blocks.text: The trigger is only as good as the geography under it. NFRI banks NESO operational-transparency congestion against each boundary's firm limit to produce a measured curtailment probability — the substrate both for the parametric index and for the aggregation factor that stops correlated boundaries from accumulating unseen.{{cite:NESO-CONSTRAINT-COSTS,NESO-CMP448}}

blocks.caption: Normalised curtailment probability by NESO constraint boundary (measured, banked 2026-06-26). Scotland and the South West run hottest; South Wales coolest.

blocks.text: The cover is underwritable only because every input is traceable to a primary source and carries an evidence tier. The same pipeline that scores the index sets the price: nothing is an LLM opinion, and the publication gate holds the whole thing at PROVISIONAL until the blended score rests on measured or disclosed evidence.{{cite:ACT-CREDIBILITY}}

blocks.caption: Register to price. Each rating fuses a deterministic register reading with a sourced latent judgement, weighted by credibility.

steps.title: Register
steps.detail: NESO TEC, DNO embedded-capacity registers and NESO congestion series — the measured base layer.{{cite:NESO-TEC,DCUSA-ECR}}

steps.title: Evidence tier
steps.detail: Every input tagged measured, disclosed, derived or assessed — the honesty layer that gates publication.

steps.title: Fusion
steps.detail: Deterministic register reading fused with a sourced latent rating, weighted by credibility (λ by tier).

steps.title: Score
steps.detail: Exposure and Preparedness on 0–100; their difference is the Margin of Safety.

steps.title: Price
steps.detail: Trigger, rate and limit derived from the score and the boundary curtailment probability.

blocks.note: Availability loss is not a gap in an existing wording; it is a different trigger. Closing it needs a new product, not an endorsement.

blocks.text: That is the whole wedge. The market deploys capacity onto whoever looks exposed and prices curtailment exposure at zero; NFRI measures availability risk at primary source, prices the Margin-of-Safety gap, and writes the availability cover that does not yet exist. Whoever holds that picture first does not sell a score — they hold the pen.{{cite:EPIC-DC-ENERGY-RISK,INDUSTRY-AGGREGATION-CONUNDRUM}}
